name: Ikeja
source: Ikeja Hotel Plc consolidated statement of comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), group column, N'000 scaled to NGN. Net finance income is stored negative; operating expenses are sales, marketing and administrative expenses. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | FY2025 and FY2024 group column re-read from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 24 of the FY2025 annual report (Revenue less Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, Gross Profit less net operating cost equals Operating Profit, Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Profit After Tax, all tie to the printed lines). Operating Expenses is the net operating cost the file's own convention uses (Gross Profit less Operating Profit). EPS aligned to the group column (645 and 333 kobo printed).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Revenue - Cost of Sales does not equal the filed Gross Profit and no other identity in the file fixes which of the two is wrong; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: EPS

unitGuard.reason: unit guard: the EPS row for FY2023 read 0.0093 against 0.959155 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.009696, which is the 100x reciprocal of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to 0.93, the unit the price is quoted in.

unit guard: the EPS row for FY2022 read -0.019 against -1.82152 for that period's net profit divided by the shares on file, a factor of 0.01043, which is the 100x reciprocal of a per-share figure printed in a sub-unit (kobo / cents / a thousandth). Normalised to -1.9, the unit the price is quoted in.

Withheld: the EPS row reads 0.0001 for FY2021, the OPPOSITE sign to the net profit reported for the same period (-1.80614e+08), and its magnitude is 0.001197x that period's net profit divided by the shares on file (-0.083526) - a figure of a different order, not a share-count basis difference. The inputs on file do not recover the printed per-share figure, so nothing is published for this period. A blank is honest; a per-share figure whose sign contradicts its own period's earnings is not.

rows.unitGuardBasis: factor = stored EPS / (the same period's net profit / shares on file); a factor within 15% of a power of ten (or its reciprocal) whose corrected value lands within 2.0x of the triangle is a UNIT error and is normalised; a stored cell of the opposite sign to the period's net profit whose magnitude is beyond 5.0x is WITHHELD with both figures named; every other cell is left exactly as filed
rows.formula: Net Profit / weighted average shares implied by the company's own reported EPS

marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

unitNormalised.basis: market-cap anchored: cap 9.62254e+10, net profit 1.39412e+10, revenue 2.58429e+10; at x1 P/E 6.90, P/S 3.723

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025, FY2023, FY2022; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note). Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit does not hold in FY2025, FY2024; the cost of sales for those periods is withheld (see the row note). Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
